project.name: Argus Tracing
project.description:
Lightweight tracing facade over the OTel SDK with switchable OTEL / Datadog backends.
Both backends use the OpenTelemetry SDK internally: OTEL — OTLP/HTTP to OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, or console in dev. DATADOG — OTLP/HTTP to DD_AGENT_HOST:4318 (Datadog agent OTLP ingestion) + Datadog Unified Service Tagging resource attributes. NOOP — discards all spans with zero overhead.
This module provides: • ArgusTracer / ArgusSpan — programmatic tracing API for teams that want it. • ArgusAgent — lifecycle manager combining logging + tracing. • UnifiedSdkInitializer — used by argus-tracing-agent for zero-code tracing.
For transparent (zero application-code) tracing, use argus-tracing-agent instead.
